items.q: What did Mark actually make after 7 days of AI dropshipping?
items.a: After **24 hours** of micro-influencer promotion: **10 genuine sales** of a breathing trainer → **$80.35 net profit** on ~**$51** total spend ($1 setup + $50 influencer). Not life-changing, but proves the model at minimal cost.

items.q: What three constraints defined the experiment?
items.a: **Free/low-cost AI tools** (shop creation under $1), **laptop only**, and **under one hour** of setup. Through-line: AI handles store, products, fulfillment; you handle **niche, polish, and marketing**.

items.q: Which tools make up the AI dropshipping stack?
items.a: **Build Your Store AI** (store + free `.store` domain) + **Shopify** (platform) + **AutoDS** (proven products, pricing, photos, fulfillment) = near-passive ops after setup. AutoDS Starter 500 was **$0.99** first 30 days.

items.q: How should you pick a niche?
items.a: By **market size + personal knowledge**, not random interest. Mark chose **sports & fitness** (son's boxing/running/gym; Gen Z running clubs). Don't be too random — customers need to know **what your store is about**.

items.q: What margin rule should you use for retail price?
items.a: The **dropshipping margin rule**: retail ≈ supplier cost × **2–2.5** (e.g. $6.84 cost → **$13.68+** sell). Add **PayPal** for trust; fill legal footer details; replace random Shopify URLs with a **`.store` domain** (Mark claims **87% more traffic** and **2× Google ranking** vs generic URLs).

items.q: What should you do before scaling ads?
items.a: **Order sample products** to verify quality — refunds from bad products kill margins. Polish pages (photos, descriptions, related upsells) before driving traffic.

Cited stats: up to **60% higher engagement** and **20%+ higher conversion** vs macro. Mark paid **$50** to Gray Brothers (~**14.5K** Instagram) for a wacky story with product link — one product tested before promoting others.

items.q: What limits showed up in the sales review?
items.a: Single-product promotion drove **no cross-sells** — only the featured breathing trainer sold. Scaling math: **20 products** with regular sales → thousands/month potential.
